objective: Independent cross-provider review of the Claude-authored Milestone 1 of the playable 3D portfolio (movement prototype plus its accepted fix rounds): physics motor and slope limit, animation state machine and clip pipeline, follow camera, shared-avatar shell integration, the clothing bake of public/avatar.glb, and the tests. Judge correctness, robustness, maintainability and test honesty; the owner has already accepted two known camera limitations (avatar occluded behind a slab on some drops; camera below ground at minimum pitch) deferred to Milestone 3.
acceptanceCriteria: The diff between baseRef and headRef was inspected in full and every finding cites a file and line in that diff.
Every requiredChecks command was executed verbatim in the working copy and its real exit code and output excerpt are recorded in crossReview.checksRun.

The hero (components/avatar, lib/persona.ts, app/api) is unchanged except public/avatar.glb, game code is not imported from the initial portfolio bundle (ADR-006 lint boundary), and the clothing bake script is deterministic and guarded as ASSETS.md claims.

Physics, animator, camera and stance tests assert behaviour that could fail (no end-state-only or always-true assertions), and the 45 degree ramp test, the stance tests and the camera drop tests would fail if their fixes were reverted.

Any correctness, robustness, resource-leak, accessibility or maintainability defect in the new game code is reported as a finding with severity; the two owner-deferred camera limitations are not findings.
constraints: Read-only: do not modify, stage, commit, stash or reset anything; the working copy is snapshotted and fingerprinted.
Run checks exactly as listed; do not substitute shorter commands. Use Node 22 if an nvm switch is needed.
Report verdict not-applicable; put the review outcome in crossReview.verdict (approved or changes-requested).
